| [TERM-090](../../../record/terms.d/TERM-090.md) v2 | effective boundary constraint, of a composite: the relation its interconnected parts impose on the variables an outside system can reach, once the interior is eliminated; approximately instantaneous or history-dependent, and, independently, possibly of a kind the parts' relations could not state | What [CLAIM-480](../../../record/claims.d/CLAIM-480.md) demonstrates and [CLAIM-474](../../../record/claims.d/CLAIM-474.md), [QUESTION-283](../../../record/questions.d/QUESTION-283.md) and [CASE-179](../../../record/cases.d/CASE-179.md) use. A composite presents the systems that interact with its boundary with a relation among its accessible variables. Its examples are the series spring's k₁k₂/(k₁ + k₂), Baez and Fong's black box, a memory kernel, and Hansen and Ghrist's three-way v₁ = v₂ + v₃. The term fixes three points: the relation is a constraint whether instantaneous or history-dependent; it is effective, not a new fundamental law; and it can exceed the parts' relational vocabulary. Adopted 2026-10-29. | Active |
| [TERM-091](../../../record/terms.d/TERM-091.md) v2 | relational vocabulary, of a class of descriptions: the arities and kinds of relation it can state (pairwise or higher-order, among states or among histories, of which declared types), and so which constraints are expressible in it at all | What [QUESTION-283](../../../record/questions.d/QUESTION-283.md) asks about: whether composition can force a description to adopt relations its parts never needed. A luria record's relational vocabulary is its declared relation types and fields, and amendments that add one ([ADR-043](../../../record/decisions.d/ADR-043.md), [ADR-044](../../../record/decisions.d/ADR-044.md)) enlarge it. | [TERM-093](../../../record/terms.d/TERM-093.md) v3 | correspondence structure, and how it is held: the maps that say which local states or descriptions of interacting systems count as agreeing, distinct from the physical coupling between them, and held as formed, discovered or adapted | The object [CLAIM-471](../../../record/claims.d/CLAIM-471.md), [QUESTION-282](../../../record/questions.d/QUESTION-282.md), [CLAIM-474](../../../record/claims.d/CLAIM-474.md) and [CASE-179](../../../record/cases.d/CASE-179.md) all turn on. It is a family of comparison maps from local descriptions into shared spaces, whose joint kernel (the global sections) is what "compatible" and "glued" mean. It is not the coupling that moves the states. How a correspondence structure is held is one of three ways: formed by physical interconnection, discovered by measurement, or adapted by an apparatus.
